title: Mouse Pancreatic Islet Isolation
author: Islet and Pancreas Analysis Core
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bz4kp8uw

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and anesthesia solutions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 0.6 mg/mL collagenase P solution: Weigh 20-30 mg collagenase P into a 50 mL conical tube, add HBSS (volume = mass/0.6), vortex for 30 seconds, and keep on ice.
Prepare HBSS with 10% FBS: Remove 50 mL from a 500 mL bottle of HBSS and add 50 mL FBS; store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.
Prepare HBSS with 1% FBS: Remove 5 mL from a 500 mL bottle of HBSS and add 5 mL FBS; store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

Prepare Ketamine (15 mg/mL)/xylazine (3 mg/mL) working solution: Inject 2 mL of xylazine into a 10 mL bottle of ketamine, then inject 2 mL of this mixture into a 10 mL bottle of saline using 5 mL syringes with 18G needles.
Pipet 6.5 mL aliquots of collagenase solution into 15 mL conical tubes.

steps.title: Set Up Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and tools for the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Set water bath to 37 °C.
Remove Histopaque from the refrigerator to warm to room temperature.
Bend a 30G needle to ~45° using forceps with the bevel facing up; store safely to avoid dulling the tip.

steps.title: Anesthetize Mice
steps.instruction: Administer anesthesia and verify the state of the mice.

substeps.instruction: Inject mice intraperitoneally with ketamine/xylazine solution (1 μl/mg body weight) using a 1 mL syringe with a 27G needle.
Place mice in a plastic bin with air holes.
After 5-10 minutes, check for full anesthetization by pinching feet and tail; if response occurs, inject an additional 100 μL of solution and wait.

steps.title: Perform Pancreatic Digestion
steps.instruction: Isolate the pancreas and perform in situ collagenase injection.

substeps.instruction: Place mouse face up on surgical stage, tape limbs, and wipe with 70% ethanol.
Open body cavity, move organs to the left, and locate the bile duct.
Ligate the bile duct with suture at the duodenum.
Remove the 18G needle from a collagenase syringe (containing 4 mL solution kept on ice) and replace it with the bent 30G needle.
Inject collagenase into the bile duct to inflate the pancreas using a surgical microscope for visualization.
Remove suture, leaving only the knot on the bile duct to prevent leakage.
Separate the pancreas from the duodenum and stomach using two pairs of forceps, starting from the head.
Remove the pancreas with the spleen still attached.
Perform cervical dislocation on the mouse and dispose of the carcass in a biohazard bag.

steps.title: Isolate Pancreas and Digest
steps.instruction: Process the pancreas to create a homogeneous slurry.

substeps.instruction: Detach the spleen, blot the pancreas on the surgical stage to remove blood, and place it into a conical tube containing collagenase solution on ice.
Secure tubes in a wrist action shaker, fully immersed in the 37 °C water bath.
Shake for a total of 8 minutes: shake for 4 minutes, remove and shake vigorously by hand 3-5 times, then return to the bath for the final 4 minutes.
Remove tubes and shake by hand for up to 2 minutes until tissue is a homogeneous slurry.

steps.title: Initial Purification
steps.instruction: Wash and concentrate the digested tissue.

substeps.instruction: Return tubes to ice and add cold HBSS with 10% FBS to reach a volume of 15 mL.
Centrifuge at 200 rcf for 1 minute at 25 °C.
Decant and wash the pellets 3X with 10 mL HBSS with 10% FBS, vortexing after each addition before centrifuging.
Discard final supernatant, add 10 mL HBSS with 10% FBS, mix by pipetting, and transfer to a 50 mL conical tube.
Wash the original tube with another 5 mL HBSS with 10% FBS and transfer to the 50 mL tube (total 15 mL digest).

steps.title: Islet Purification via Gradient
steps.instruction: Use Histopaque to separate islets from the digest.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the tubes and gently underlay the digest with 15 mL of Histopaque gradient using a manual bulb pipet filler.
Centrifuge at 500 rcf for 10 minutes at 25 °C.
Transfer the islet layer to a new 50 mL tube containing 15 mL HBSS with 1% FBS using a 25 mL pipet.
Centrifuge at 500 rcf for 10 minutes at 25 °C.

steps.title: Final Wash and Recovery
steps.instruction: Perform final washes and recover islets for picking.

substeps.instruction: Decant and wash the pellets 3X with 25 mL HBSS with 1% FBS, vortexing after each addition before centrifuging.
After final decanting, add 10 mL HBSS with 10% FBS, mix by pipetting, and transfer to a 10 cm untreated culture dish.
Wash the tube with another 5 mL HBSS with 10% FBS and transfer to the dish (total 15 mL digest).
Place the culture plate on an inverted microscope stage.
View and pick islets at 4x magnification using a P-200 pipette with ART tips.
